blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.q: Is Elgin Chantrell an official City of Surrey neighbourhood?
faq.a: No — it is a Paragon (MLS) board sub-area name combining two local names, Elgin and Chantrell Creek. The City of Surrey publishes no single boundary for "Elgin Chantrell" and uses the two local names separately, as does the school district.

faq.q: How did Elgin Chantrell sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 74 active listings, 10 solds and a 14% sales ratio — joint with Grandview, behind Hazelmere (29%) and Pacific Douglas (15%) in the S Surrey White Rock set — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 13 listings and no solds; medians are published at community level only (S Surrey White Rock detached $1,628,000; attached $700,000) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are in Elgin Chantrell?
faq.a: Schools confirmed by name and address against the BC Ministry K-12 file in the pocket are Chantrell Creek Elementary (2575 137 St) and Elgin Park Secondary (13484 24 Ave), with Crescent Park Elementary (2440 128 St) at the western end — but SD36 catchments are address-based and no locator result for an Elgin Chantrell address is on record, so check the exact address before relying on a school (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/education/work/bc_k12_schools.csv, read 2026-11-01).

Elgin Heritage Park on Crescent Road — a City-designated heritage site at the Historic Stewart Farm (Stewart Farmhouse, 13723 Crescent Road) on the Nicomekl River — and Sunnyside Acres Urban Forest Park, a 140-hectare second-growth forest at 2598 144 Street with about four kilometres of nature trails including the 0.8-km Wally Ross universal access trail.
